name: resource-header
description: Header of a resource or press release page. variant "band" (default) is live's article band (www.assetpanda.com case study / success story / white paper / press pages): breadcrumbs, then a deep-indigo rounded band holding the H1, the letter-spaced type label, category chips, date and share links beside the featured photo; image_side puts the photo left (live's case studies) or right. variant "article" is the 2026 post design (Figma Blog Detail 5434:79954 and the compare post 7219:87997): breadcrumbs (home icon first), the indigo eyebrow, the H1, a 'Share on:' row above a rule, then the featured image full width with rounded corners, all over a soft centred gradient wash that fades to white.

variant.description: band = live's deep-indigo band; article = the 2026 post design (light, image below the title).

crumbs.description: Breadcrumb trail before the title. Each: label (required), url, icon ('home' draws the home icon in place of the label; article variant).

label.description: Resource type, e.g. Success Story. The band's letter-spaced label; the article variant's indigo eyebrow (a compare post's 'Compare Asset Panda', a blog post's category).

categories.description: Category chips (band only). Each: label (required), url.

share_url.description: Page URL for the share links; no share row when empty.

share_label.description: The design's article header says 'Share on:'.

wash.description: Article only: draw the gradient wash behind the header.
